value.rationale: This is the exact natural strong-Hilbert maximal invariant and complete extremizer classification for the triangular prism, the smallest nonbipartite cubic graph and one of only two cubic graphs on six vertices. Its extremizers localize at precisely the six distance-two pairs with a nontrivial radical contrast; this provides a finite-graph analytic benchmark rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. No larger-graph or downstream theorem is asserted.
